t: The Hillbrush Medium Banister Brush is a versatile hand tool designed for removing dirt, dust and debris efficiently. Its compact 255mm size and lightweight natural wood construction make it ideal for detailed sweeping tasks across workshops, construction sites, and domestic environments. Filled with medium-stiff bassine fibres, it offers a good balance of sweeping performance and control, making it suitable for workbenches, steps, shelves, workshops, utility areas and general cleaning tasks. The timber handle ensures a comfortable grip and robust performance for everyday trade and DIY cleaning requirements, offering greater control than larger brooms.
